opening.id: Dengan penuh sukacita, kami mengundang Bapak/Ibu/Saudara/i untuk hadir pada hari pernikahan kami.
opening.en: With great joy, we invite you to attend our wedding day.

rsvpHint.id: Mohon kabari kami apakah Anda dapat hadir.
rsvpHint.en: Please let us know whether you can attend.

closing.id: Merupakan kehormatan bagi kami atas kehadiran Bapak/Ibu/Saudara/i.
closing.en: Your presence would be an honour for us.

originality.statement: Original design for this repository: a generated eight-point geometric tile in emerald and gold behind a framed cover, an open gesture that starts a synthesised chime, and staggered reveals. No scripture, prayer or calligraphy is included (no owner-approved corpus entry exists, ADR-O04). No competitor page, asset, wording or layout was used as a reference.
